scope: Independent facilitator review of attempt-002 proposals; not production proof verification

candidate_1.finding: The proposed gate depends on history length but not history record contents; the adjective guided is unsupported.

candidate_2.finding: Original review omitted stronger existing exact u64 membership and fresh/duplicate decision contracts; finite-window state invariant still needs careful comparison rather than absence-by-name.
candidate_2.important_boundary: Ring-buffer public contracts constrain count, capacity and indexed written/read values but do not expose a complete logical FIFO-sequence invariant or whole-state unchanged-on-rejection. No claim that all desired FIFO dedup semantics already compose is established by this facilitator review.

candidate_3.finding: Counterexample disproves preservation of the proposed used<=limit invariant.
candidate_3.execution: Python 3 evaluation of the exact model-proposed arithmetic; no Rust implementation and no Verus invocation
candidate_3.additional_objection: Repeated carry_idle can re-credit unchanged unused capacity without a period transition.
candidate_3.arithmetic_duplication: rate_limit::tokens_after_refill_spec(tokens,1000,unused,burst) computes min(tokens+unused,burst), and try_consume_spec already returns unchanged state on insufficient credit.
